sections.title: charaNam 2
lyrics: biLiya kAgada hrdaya bAyi kalamadAni - nAligE yEmbOdu lEkhaniyu
shrIlOlana kathE divya nAmangaLa - shIla manadhi barEdu harigE oppisuvantha

sections.title: charaNam 3
lyrics: mundaNa Agama samsArada bAdhE - yEndendigu adhara bhaya biTTithu
hiNdaNa sancitha sAla bhArakkElla - sandAyavanu mADi kathabi harisi biTTa

sections.title: charaNam 4
lyrics: nuDi nuDigAnanda bAshpa rOmAncana - muDupinoLage iTTa kaijIthavu
kaDeya sambaLakella mukuti sAdanavannu - koDuvante tirugada chITi barEsi koTTa

sections.title: charaNam 5
lyrics: khanda KhandavarigE kArpaNyava bittu - mandE addAgi nA baLala lilla
pundarikAksha shri purandharavittalanu - dhandisi vILyava koTTu sEvEyoLiTTa
